notes: Phase 3 (03-FEATURE-SPECS.md §Commitments & Promises, 02-DATA-SCHEMAS.md Commitment). Ownership shape (c) joint-log, same as PlannerEvent — both partners write directly to one shared list (shared_commitments). The two sync gates (commitment:created, commitment:status_changed) and the storage helpers live in shared/eravos-kernel.js, cross-cutting — checked against cross-file callers before deciding, learned from the poke/feelingToOracle mistakes: the future Relational Health derived view (next in this phase) will read this same data from wherever it lives, so it has to stay correct regardless of whether this tab is mounted. Status changes to 'missed' or 'renegotiated' require a reflection note before saving (not punitive — what got in the way, what changed); 'kept' doesn't. status_history is append-only — a missed commitment that's later kept gets a new history entry, never an edit to the old one.
